title: System integration layer
objective: Deliver AppManager resource lifecycle, zram configuration, Linux service adapters and a remote-navigable Quick Settings surface.
constraints: The UI never invokes NetworkManager, BlueZ, wpctl, xrandr, UDisks2 or logind directly.
Default policy allows one heavy foreground app plus explicitly permitted background work.
No sudo invocation is exposed as a generic UI escape hatch.
acceptance: NetworkManager, BlueZ, wpctl/WirePlumber, xrandr, UDisks2 and logind are reachable only through project adapter contracts.
Quick Settings can complete common Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio, display and power tasks by remote.
Adapters expose recoverable user-level errors instead of raw service/CLI errors.
Hardware integration tests cover at least the primary reference machine.
AppManager applies MemoryHigh, MemoryMax, CPUWeight and IOWeight through systemd/cgroups v2.
zram is configurable and its active state is visible to diagnostics.

history.reason: Roadmap outcome defined; acceptance may be amended before LOCKED.
P02 scope reconciled with the canonical MVP and adapter contracts are ready.
Host implementation proceeds while the P01 image gate is externally pending.
